kapellbruecke.name: Chapel Bridge
kapellbruecke.slogan: Europe's oldest wooden bridge, rebuilt after the fire of 1993.
kapellbruecke.line: On 18 August 1993 a fire destroyed much of the bridge and its gable paintings; it reopened in April 1994.

pilatuskulm.name: Mount Pilatus
pilatuskulm.slogan: Dragon mountain, reached by the steepest cogwheel railway on earth.
pilatuskulm.line: Since it opened in 1889, the Pilatus railway has kept its maximum gradient of 48 percent.

loewendenkmal.name: Lion Monument
loewendenkmal.slogan: A wounded lion, carved straight into a quiet sandstone cliff.
loewendenkmal.line: The most mournful and moving piece of stone in the world.

rigivitznau.name: Rigi Kulm
rigivitznau.slogan: The Queen of the Mountains, with a view over half of Switzerland.
rigivitznau.line: The Vitznau-Rigi railway opened on 21 May 1871 as the first mountain railway in Europe.

ruetli.name: Rütli Meadow
ruetli.slogan: A lakeside meadow where Switzerland says it began.
ruetli.line: The Rütli oath is first recorded in the White Book of Sarnen, written around 1470, a century after the event.
